description: The kumi skill contract. This file is the single source of truth for what makes a valid specialist. tests/validate_skills.py reads it, so changing the contract here changes validation everywhere. Edit this, not the scripts.
command_skills_note: User-only commands, not specialists. They need name and description, disable-model-invocation: true, no allowed-tools, and no shell line; the specialist metadata, hard gate, and sections do not apply.
